issues.on_page: Payment in lieu of taxes waiver 3,803.58 (nonoperating revenues)
issues.issue: Judgment call. A PILOT waiver is the village giving up the in-lieu-of-tax payment it is owed, so it is in effect a local-government contribution (intergovernmental/state aid). 'other' is defensible because the page doesn't explain it, and the line is already marked review.
